actions: Performed the sharper geometry-sufficiency intervention requested by the prior checkpoint: imposed an explicit circular hidden-state target on the same source-equation leaky LayerNorm RNN while retaining per-step direction cross-entropy.

The geometry target was a fixed two-dimensional circular subspace embedded in 64 hidden units; each class was assigned cos(theta),sin(theta) coordinates scaled to unit per-feature variance. This is deliberately stronger and less biological than the paper's emergent manifold and is used only as a causal sufficiency test.

A regularization weight lambda=4 produced one seed with matched clean accuracy and hidden PR near the paper's reported direction-manifold dimensionality; two other seeds reached similarly low PR but suffered larger accuracy losses, exposing optimization instability of the explicit constraint.

Evaluated the matched seed on exactly the same all-gap random-interpolation and 50% frame-dropout realizations as the unconstrained source-like RNN, and measured the same hidden-state perturbation recovery diagnostic.

geometry_intervention.regularizer: MSE from per-step normalized hidden state to a fixed 2D circular class prototype embedded in 64D, added to the paper-like per-step cross-entropy
geometry_intervention.interpretation: For the seed where clean accuracy was closely matched, forcing hidden dimensionality from PR~7.0 toward PR~2.9 did not strengthen long-horizon contraction (0.284 versus 0.275 RMS ratio at step30) and reduced all-gap interpolation accuracy from 84.4% to 75.0%. Dropout was essentially unchanged. Across seeds the ring constraint also produced unstable accuracy. Therefore low-dimensional circular geometry, by itself, is not sufficient to explain the robustness seen in the unconstrained source-like recurrent control under this reduced generator. The stronger supported factor remains loss-over-time/per-step primitive supervision, while the exact published attractor geometry may still matter in the 512-unit/1e6-episode/source-generator regime.
scope: The ring is imposed by an artificial hidden-state regularizer; the paper reports emergent geometry without this loss. This intervention tests sufficiency, not fidelity.

Only one lambda=4 seed achieved clean accuracy close enough to the unconstrained model for a useful paired robustness comparison; two seeds had substantial accuracy loss, so no broad negative claim about low-dimensional manifolds is warranted.
The matched seed's PR~2.9 is closer to but not equal to the publication's ~2.11.
The official 512-unit source generator and training code remain unavailable through the current public transport.

evidence_added_this_segment: An explicit 2D circular hidden-state constraint reduced late hidden PR to 2.91 in a matched-clean seed but did not improve perturbation contraction and reduced source-like all-gap interpolation accuracy from 84.4% to 75.0%.
Across three seeds lambda=4 yielded PR 2.25-2.91 but clean accuracy 61.9%-93.1%, indicating that simply enforcing near-2D geometry can destabilize the reduced training problem.

The unconstrained per-step RNN still strongly outperformed the final-only recurrent control, while a parameter-matched non-recurrent temporal encoder remained competitive or better on input corruption.
candidate_update.interpretation: The current reduced evidence separates three claims: recurrence alone is insufficient; per-step primitive supervision robustly sculpts contractive dynamics; low-dimensional circular geometry is not sufficient by itself in the tested reduced system. The published input-driven attractor mechanism remains plausible but its causal contribution requires the official generator/full-scale training or a geometry-destroying intervention that preserves clean performance.
candidate_update.exact_next_action: Prioritize exact artifact recovery for Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16441066. If still blocked, attempt a geometry-necessity test rather than another sufficiency constraint: start from a high-accuracy source-like recurrent model, identify its task-relevant low-dimensional subspace, selectively scramble/rotate only manifold-tangent organization while preserving output logits/clean accuracy as closely as possible, and measure perturbation contraction plus interpolation/dropout. In parallel search public citing work for a non-author rerun. If necessity also fails, downgrade attractor-specific causality and retain distributed temporal supervision + primitive isolation as the supported transferable mechanism.
